title: Mixed-Material Periodic Stack with Reduced Index Contrast
scientific_hypothesis: A Si3N4/MgF2 periodic stack with 12 layer pairs can achieve comparable dual-bandpass performance to high-contrast Si/SiO2 designs while offering reduced mechanical stress and better thermal matching to Daimon-20 substrate.
design_principle: Lower index contrast (Si3N4/MgF2 Δn ~ 1.0 vs Si/SiO2 Δn ~ 2.4) requires more layers for equivalent stopband depth but may provide better mechanical stability and thermal compatibility. This tests whether layer count can compensate for reduced contrast within the 24-layer limit.
proposed_topology: Air | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Si3N4 | MgF2 | Daimon-20 substrate, 24 coating layers total
design_variables: individual thicknesses of all 24 coating layers
manufacturing_considerations: Si3N4 and MgF2 are conventional IR dielectrics per L05 review
Lower stress than Si/SiO2 on Daimon-20
MgF2 requires careful deposition to avoid moisture absorption
theory_basis: Periodic stack theory with lower index contrast
Layer count compensation for reduced Δn
Material compatibility with substrate per L05 multilayer review
expected_advantages: Better thermal expansion match to Daimon-20 than Si
Lower mechanical stress reduces delamination risk
known_risks: 24 layers at maximum limit leaves no margin for additional matching layers
Lower index contrast may not achieve required stopband depth
Si3N4 absorption may be higher than SiO2 in mid-IR
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer periodic stack on CaF2 (Daimon-20) substrate under air normal incidence. Stack structure: Air | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | Si3N4 (Kischkat) | MgF2 | CaF2 (Daimon-20). Vary all 24 coating layer thicknesses independently. Target high transmittance at 4.15-4.35 μm and 4.55-4.75 μm. Target low transmittance at 3.60-4.00 μm and 4.85-5.20 μm. No metal layers. Materials: Si3N4 (Kischkat), mgf2. Substrate: CaF2 (Daimon-20). Maximum 24 layers at limit.
